Bill.BriefDescription: Studying whether to require a class in first aid for high school graduation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to first aid classes for high school students; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The state board of education shall reviewthe need for having a class in first aid as a requirement for highschool graduation and report its findings to appropriate committees ofthe legislature by December 1, 2007.
